subject: Unable to run sniny app on shiny server open

messages.author: b0f2dfb8fce671d2
messages.subject: Unable to run sniny app on shiny server open
parts:
Hi,

I have successfully installed shiny server open (shiny-server-1.4.2.786-rh5-x86_64.rpm) in RHEL 6.5 (64 bit) but when i try to access the sample application provided as a part of shiny server i get the following error.

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : unable to load shared object '/usr/lib64/R/library/Rcpp/libs/Rcpp.so': /usr/lib64/R/library/Rcpp/libs/Rcpp.so: invalid ELF header In addition: Warning message: package ‘shiny’ was built under R version 3.3.0 Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘shiny’ Execution halted


Can someday let me know what the issue is?
